# Probity AI

> Tools and run records for checking claims about agent actions.

## Guides

- [Choose a project](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/start.md): Tools grouped by the task you need.
- [Automation](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/automation.md): Read the catalog and pinned run records.
- [Open Evidence Lab](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab.md): Retained runs, submissions and corrections.
- [Find a retained run](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/runs.md): Search recorded claims, declared roles, limits and original evidence.
- [Assurance atlas](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/atlas.md): Projects, mechanisms and evidence boundaries.
- [Experiments](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/experiments.md): Pinned procedures and recorded results.
- [Replay an evidence decision](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/replay-an-evidence-decision.md): A retained admission and its state-preserving refusals.
- [Run the APS and PriorSeal replay](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/replay-tools.md): Declare the caller and retain pinned sources, process logs and results.
- [Interpret a green test suite](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/evidence-test-meaning.md): Separate test outcomes, record validity and action results using retained artifacts.
- [Claim ledger](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/claims.md): Sources and re-derive commands.
- [Versions and source pins](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/versions.md): Published releases, reviewed guides and historical result pins.
- [Repository guide](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/repository.md): Sources, checks and the site build.

## Projects

- [Probity Admission](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-admission/blob/f00f04b888a5694de03304f0481addb2a75b98a8/README.md): Component ID: `admission`. Provides a Python artifact-digest checker, admission policies for OPA, Kyverno and policy-controller, and a pre-call budget reservation API.
- [Probity APS refund example](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/753932b42b00ab8257396112c529f840396f0ce7/docs/APS-REFUND-RETRIES.md): Profile ID: `aps-refund-retries`. Component ID: `observer`. Runs a local APS refund example that ties retries to approved actions and retains records for a separate reader.
- [Probity artifact digest check](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-admission/blob/f00f04b888a5694de03304f0481addb2a75b98a8/python/README.md): Profile ID: `artifact-digest-check`. Component ID: `admission`. Checks an artifact against digests named by a TEA document, CycloneDX SBOM or VEX, or in-toto statement.
- [Probity Atlas](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-atlas/blob/ec67f0375e008cb7befc19a31762490b5cbbe520/README.md): Component ID: `atlas`. Provides task-based project navigation, agent assurance documentation and an Open Evidence Lab run register.
- [Checkout composition reference](https://github.com/probityai/agent-checkout-runner/blob/297b5b182bb40605b62586eccbf93a9c68a4aee1/README.md): Component ID: `checkout-runner`. Runs a bounded synthetic checkout and refund composition as a CLI or Action, with separate decisions, attempts, effects and observations for offline replay.
- [dsse](https://github.com/probityai/dsse/blob/8549e5e54080b5f8c864f8b3eba8f57af8bd9c51/README.md): Component ID: `dsse`. Signs and verifies DSSE envelopes with explicit threshold and key handling.
- [Probity native Inspect reader](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/71ac0b2126473316655184235000647a6dd0f5cf/docs/NATIVE-CONSUMER-CI.md): Profile ID: `inspect-native-reader`. Component ID: `observer`. Reads selected retained Inspect execution profiles offline, preserving errors and unstarted attempts. Inspect accepted the catalog entry, and the live Inspect extensions catalog lists it as of October 14, 2026.
- [jcs-admit](https://github.com/probityai/jcs-admit/blob/0a058d7b676fb452929337c528b893c7f2121062/README.md): Component ID: `jcs-admit`. Checks raw JSON input before producing its RFC 8785 canonical form.
- [Probity MintID trace reader](https://github.com/probityai/jcs-admit/blob/fb32a68aa2772e51cee32bc14835075d88af3953/interop/mintid-trace-records-v2/README.md): Profile ID: `mintid-trace-records-v2`. Component ID: `jcs-admit`. Reads published MintID trace records after raw JSON admission and checks source-bound evidence and actor attribution.
- [Probity Observer](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/f9fd4a13fb31da5f990fd8da82472ed4cedb5f97/README.md): Component ID: `observer`. Records brokered file actions with signed packets and history, and reads selected native delegation evidence offline.
- [Probity Ratchet](https://github.com/probityai/ratchet/blob/0e5a9c1059d4f7a77694289a75c39c7b1682313a/README.md): Component ID: `ratchet`. Provides a source-tagged agent guard harness, signed admission records and public regression cases.
- [Probity Ratchet public cases](https://github.com/probityai/ratchet/blob/b6504260db8af7d3746e9ac87740430dd988e8d9/probity-ratchet-cases/README.md): Profile ID: `ratchet-cases`. Component ID: `ratchet`. Grades agent tasks in a simulated company on final state, with declared tool faults, traps and benign cases. All shipped splits are public.
- [Probity Vectors](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/9e596fbff7bb29809d38319aebb56f2141923eb2/README.md): Component ID: `vectors`. Provides conformance cases and reference verifiers for selected agent evidence formats.
- [Probity Verify](https://github.com/probityai/probity-verify/blob/b920366397cb131232163706864a70723b867367/README.md): Component ID: `verify`. Checks supplied evidence bytes through claim-specific offline adapters. Its README links to source-pinned installation and checked task recipes.
- [Probity Vocabulary](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vocabulary/blob/220a4f0a08b90a555a430bb7d4334eb2617d05ba/README.md): Component ID: `vocabulary`. Defines versioned terms and crosswalks for claims about agent execution.
- [Probity witnessed run selection](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-observer/blob/d53776c7b783abbce42a3422f56ed390dfedd2f2/docs/WITNESSED-RUN-SELECTION.md): Profile ID: `witnessed-run-selection`. Component ID: `observer`. Checks a supplied run against consumer-retained witness anchors, plan and control pins, and execution closure.

## Data

- [Project catalog](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/catalog.json): Stable project IDs, tasks and pinned README sources.
- [Lab register](https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-atlas/lab/register.json): Retained artifacts, results and review state.
